Use case: illustration-story. ONE new FULL-BODY illustration of adult FREYA SKALD as a shieldmaiden in her COMPLETE blue-and-gold armor, with her cheerful horse ELDFAXI beside her.
Reference 1 binds Freya's face: twenty years old, long straight golden blond hair and soft fringe, warm BROWN eyes, bright gentle confident smile. Reference 2 binds her costume design: rounded gold cuirass and pauldrons, gold forearm guards, charcoal underlayers, deep blue cape and blue gold-edged skirt, small blue/gold brooch. Equip the complete shieldmaiden version for this portrait: fitted practical gold breastplate, matching shoulder/arm guards, segmented gold waist protection over a closed blue padded tunic, steel/gold greaves and sturdy brown riding boots. Fully armored combat attire with no exposed chest, belly or thighs. Head uncovered so her identity is clear. A plain straight SWORD held low with point safely down in one hand, a round deep-blue wooden SHIELD with gold rim and modest gold musical/leaf ornament on the other arm. Keep her cheerful, artistic personality, not a fierce grim warrior.
Reference 3 is binding ELDFAXI identity: a sturdy Hest-cross mare with cream/white coat and irregular dark charcoal patches and spots, black/dark stormy mane and tail, shaggy feathered lower legs, brown leather saddle over a muted red saddlecloth and simple brown bridle. NOT a brown bay, not a gray horse, not white-maned. She stands contentedly beside Freya with ears forward, relaxed bright eyes and softly parted lips as if brumming along with a song. Horse expression happy and natural, no human teeth.
COMPLETELY natural horse anatomy and composition: place Freya on the left and the horse on the right in a clearly readable BROADSIDE SIDE VIEW, head pointing LEFT toward Freya, long HORIZONTAL back and barrel, saddle on the back, rounded hindquarters and tail on the right. Two front legs under shoulders, two hind legs under hips, all FOUR separate legs and FOUR hooves visible and planted in a gentle staggered stance. No foreshortened frontal upright torso or twisted anatomy. Horse is a real sturdy riding horse in natural proportion to the woman. Camera far enough back to fit the ENTIRE horse from ears to tail and all hooves, Freya's boots, shield, sword tip and cape inside the 2:3 frame with ample margin. No limb hiding behind Freya.
Quiet grassy path outside a northern Klangheim timber hall, distant firs and hills, warm clear daylight. No crowd, additional animals, banners, readable text or extra equipment. Bildformat 2:3. No captions, floating musical notes, watermark, panels or frame.
